scripts.test:svelte: FRAMEWORK=svelte pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.svelte.config.ts
scripts.test:react: FRAMEWORK=react pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.react.config.ts
scripts.test:vue: FRAMEWORK=vue pnpm exec playwright test -c playwright.vue.config.ts
scripts.test:angular: mkdir -p test-results && PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME=test-results/report.json PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OPEN=never FRAMEWORK=ng playwright test -c playwright.angular.config.ts --project=chromium --project=ng-known-failures --reporter=list,json,html ; node check-known-failures.mjs test-results/report.json
